title: PRC-linked influence operations are targeting AI debates in the US
summary: A new report from OpenAI details PRC-linked influence operations using AI to target U.S. tech debates, data center narratives, tariffs, and false claims about ChatGPT.
body: A new report from OpenAI details PRC-linked influence operations using AI to target U.S. tech debates, data center narratives, tariffs, and false claims about ChatGPT.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了一项新报告，详细披露了与中国相关的网络影响力行动如何利用AI工具干预美国的技术辩论、数据中心叙事、关税问题以及散布关于ChatGPT的虚假言论。
